input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it’s either not working at all or it’s extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone while I’m abroad in France. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.
Yes, I can check those things on my phone. Just let me know what you’d like me to look at or do first, and I’ll follow your instructions.

Here’s what I see on my status bar:
- No airplane icon is present.
- Signal strength is excellent (full bars).
- The network type displayed is 5G.
- There is a mobile data icon showing data is enabled.
- I also see a Data Saver icon.
- No VPN icon is visible.

What should I do next?
I’ve turned Data Saver mode off. The icon is no longer showing in my status bar. What would you like me to do next to check if my internet speed has improved?
I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said there’s no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I try next?

I checked both things you mentioned:
1. My SIM card status says it’s active and working.
2. The APN settings show the APN name as “internet” and the MMSC URL as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Nothing looks unusual or missing.

What should I try next?

I reset my APN settings to default and rebooted my phone as you instructed. Unfortunately, after trying again, the speed test still fails and says there’s no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I do next?

Yes, please transfer me to a human agent for advanced technical support. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone while I’m abroad, so I’d appreciate any further help they can provide. Thank you!

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.

Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.

messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it’s either not working at all or it’s extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone while I’m abroad in France. Can you help me fix this?

To assist you with your mobile data issue, I’ll need to identify your account first. Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account,
- Your full name and date of birth (in YYYY-MM-DD format), or
- Your customer ID (if you have it)?

Once I have this information, I can check your line and help resolve your data connectivity problem.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

Thank you for confirming your details. I see your line ending in 2002 is active, has international roaming enabled, and is on the Premium Plan with a 15GB monthly data limit. You’ve used about 8.7GB so far, so you still have data available.

To help resolve your slow or non-working mobile data while abroad, I’ll need you to perform a few quick checks on your phone. Are you able to run some diagnostic actions, such as checking your status bar or network status? If so, please let me know, and I’ll guide you through the steps.
Yes, I can check those things on my phone. Just let me know what you’d like me to look at or do first, and I’ll follow your instructions.

Great! Let’s start by checking your phone’s status bar for important indicators. Please do the following:

1. Check your status bar (the area at the top of your phone’s screen) and let me know:
   - Do you see an airplane icon (✈️)?
   - What is your signal strength (bars or icon)?
   - What network type is displayed (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE, 3G, E)?
   - Is there a mobile data icon (📱 or similar)?
   - Are there any other icons, such as a VPN (🔒) or Data Saver (🔽)?

Please describe what you see, and I’ll guide you through the next steps based on your answers.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔽 Data Saver | 🔋 80%

Here’s what I see on my status bar:
- No airplane icon is present.
- Signal strength is excellent (full bars).
- The network type displayed is 5G.
- There is a mobile data icon showing data is enabled.
- I also see a Data Saver icon.
- No VPN icon is visible.

What should I do next?

Thank you for the details! Since your Data Saver icon is visible, this means Data Saver mode is ON, which can restrict your data speed and usage, especially while abroad.

Please turn OFF Data Saver mode on your phone. After you do this, try using your mobile data again and let me know if your internet speed improves. If you need instructions on how to turn off Data Saver mode, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I can guide you through the steps.

Data Saver Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned Data Saver mode off. The icon is no longer showing in my status bar. What would you like me to do next to check if my internet speed has improved?

Great job turning off Data Saver mode! Next, please run a speed test on your phone to check your current internet speed. Most phones have a built-in speed test option, or you can use a trusted app or website like Speedtest.net.

After you run the speed test, please let me know:
- The download speed result (in Mbps or the quality rating, e.g., excellent, good, fair, poor)
- If you notice any improvement in your browsing or app usage

This will help determine if your mobile data speed has improved or if we need to try additional troubleshooting steps.
Speed test failed: No Connection.
I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said there’s no connection. My mobile data still isn’t working. What should I try next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since your phone shows 5G and full signal but the speed test fails, let’s check a few more things that could block your data connection.

Please do the following:
1. Check your SIM card status. On your phone, look for an option like “SIM status” or “About phone” > “SIM status.” Let me know if it says the SIM is active, missing, or locked.
2. Check your APN (Access Point Name) settings. Look for “Mobile Network” > “Access Point Names” in your settings and let me know if anything looks unusual or if the APN is missing.

If you’re not sure how to check these, let me know your phone type (Android or iPhone), and I’ll provide step-by-step instructions.
Your SIM card is active and working.

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc

2. The APN settings show the APN name as “internet” and the MMSC URL as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Nothing looks unusual or missing.

What should I try next?

Thank you for checking those details. Since your SIM is active and your APN settings appear correct, let’s try resetting your APN settings to default, as sometimes hidden configuration issues can cause data problems, especially when roaming internationally.

Please reset your APN settings to default on your phone. After resetting, you must reboot (restart) your device for the changes to take effect.

Once you’ve done both steps (reset APN and reboot), try using your mobile data again and let me know if your internet connection is restored or if you’re still having issues.
